notes.title: Very Positive on Steam ♥
notes.content:
[p]Hello friends,[/p][p]
Since the release of June 30th, we’ve been reading your reviews, and our hearts are full. Your kind words, thoughtful feedback, and cozy vibes have truly lit up our little developer campfire.[/p][p][/p][p]When we set out to create [i]Rekindled Trails[/i], we hoped to craft a gentle journey that would feel like a warm blanket on a rainy day, and seeing so many of you connect with that feeling means the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p]From tales of relaxing afternoons spent in the forest to screenshots of your favorite peaceful spots, each message reminds us why we do what we do. [/p][p][/p][p]So from the whole team: [b]thank you for walking these trails with us.[/b] ♥[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve got more peaceful paths and small surprises planned for the future, but for now… take a deep breath, stretch your legs, and enjoy the calm.[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the trail. ✨
Kiwick & NAGA[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.2

[*]Fixed some places where you could get stuck by dashing

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.1

[list]
[*]Added an "unstuck" button

[*]Fixed issue with not being able to get through breakdown

[/list]
